name: Authenticated local PII NER spans
logic_name: Independent companion-model span detection and reversible masking

test_list.description: The authenticated worker runs the separately configured PII model on exact raw text and returns bounded half-open UTF-8 byte offsets only.
Out-of-bounds, reversed, oversized, non-finite-confidence, and non-character-boundary spans fail closed before vault writes.
NER spans join DFA and entropy spans in one bounded vault pass, use existing Other kind, and unmask only at the authorized sandbox boundary.
Malformed model byte ranges are rejected before vault mutation and trigger deterministic masking fallback.
Unavailable companion model or timed-out/cancelled detection leaves DFA and entropy masking active and reports degraded coverage.
The authenticated client enforces its configured deadline on the PII span RPC.
Overlapping detector spans merge, and already-issued markers remain intact under repeated or overbroad spans.
Issued-marker preservation uses a bounded prefix scan with many vault entries and unrelated text.
Worker health process incarnations differ across process owners.
A restart produces a different model cache identity even when digest and generation are unchanged.
Ignored artifact-backed acceptance test; it requires a pinned local PII model and ONNX Runtime and has not been run.

inputs.name: raw_text
inputs.description: Bounded local text before Decide normalization; never written to logs or serialized outside the authenticated local worker transport.

inputs.name: spans
inputs.description: Half-open byte ranges and confidence values; the wire response carries no matched text or model labels.

output_description: Reversible bounded output with truthful NER coverage status; unavailable detection falls back to deterministic DFA and entropy masking.
